# Vendored fixture for the opt-in live IaC test (tests/unit/test_iac_scanner.py).
# Deliberately insecure: runs as root (no USER directive) and uses a :latest tag
# -> trivy config reports HIGH/MEDIUM misconfigurations (e.g. AVD-DS-0002 root
# user, AVD-DS-0001 :latest). The live test copies this content to a tmp file
# named "Dockerfile" so trivy's filename heuristic detects it.
FROM ubuntu:latest

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl

COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app

# No USER directive -> container runs as root (AVD-DS-0002).
CMD ["/app/run.sh"]
